tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// li ma brtag pa'i rab byed smra ba 'dod pa'i kha rgyan bzhugs so//

thugs rje'i chu gter zas gtsang sras kyi bu// 'jam mgon snying stobs rdzogs pa'i zla ba ni// smra mkhas 'dod pa'i snying la bdud rtsi'i rgyun// gsar pa sbyin mkhas de la phyag 'tshal lo// brtag pa sbrang rtsi'i nyid khu 'thungs gyur pa'i// dbyangs can lang tsho rgyas pa'i skye bo ni// chen po'i 'dun sar ya mtshan gtam gleng tshe// lugs shes phur bu bzhin du grags par 'gyur// lus can bsod nams myu gu'i zhing gyur pa'i// rgyal dang de sras sku rten sngon byung ba// rnam par dbye tshe kun gyi dbyangs can ma// thob pa'i rig byed tshangs pas ma dran 'di'o// rgya gar bod dang hor dang rgya nag bzhi// rgya gar la yang dbus 'gyur shar nub dang*// lho byang re rer spyi dang bye brag dbye// dbus 'gyur yul du zi khyim li dmar dang*// li dkar zangs dmar byang chub shing dang ni// klu 'jim rdo ba dag las bsgrubs pa ste// zi khyim sin dhu'i chu klung dag gi 'gram// gser bzhin chags pas gser dmar yin par grags// 'di la klu yi rin chen sna bdun po// ma lus 'dus pas yid bzhin nor bu bzhin// kha dog cher dmar zhib brtags 'ja' 'od snang*// dug chus reg na dbang po'i gzhu nyid ston// li dmar dmar dwangs cung zad ser ba dang*// li dkar dkar dwangs cung zad ser ba yin// 'di gnyis li yul ri la thub dbang bzhis// byin gyis brlabs pa las 'ongs mchog tu bsngags// sku sha li dkar na bza' li dmar gyis// byas pa dag la zangs thang ma zhes 'bod// zangs dmar rtogs bla byang chub ljon shing gi /yal ga las grub 'di reg ngan song med//de shākya thub pas smon lam btab pa'i phyir ro// dang zhing 'bol ba klu yi 'jim pa dang*// dkar zhing mkhregs pa kā ma ru yi rdo// rdo mnyen nag po bsil ba'i tshal nas 'ong*// thub pa'i sku tshogs sngon tshe thub dbang gis// ri mo mkhan la brir bcug ma nus pas// rang gi sku dang 'tsham pa'i 'od zer bkye// de steng ri mos mnan pa'i bris sku zhig

/siṅga li rgyal bu mo'i mu tig 'khri shing zer skyes lan gnang*// 'di rigs skem sbag snyoms shing gtsug tor drang*// shangs rgyud mtho zhing sbyang la shangs rtse rno// mdzod spu shangs rtse thig btab bzhin du drangs// spyan bar dog cing mchu sgros gtsang ba dang*/ skyil krung mtha' thig shangs rtser reg pa dang*// na bza' phal cher sha mi sgrib pa mang*// lha sa'i jo bo rin chen 'di rigs yin// gos 'khyud nyung ba'i sku sha sgrib pa'ang srid// gzhan pa ma ga dha'i rgyal po gzugs can snying pos sgra sgrogs kyi// rgyal po'i u dra ya na tsan dan jo bo bzheng mkhan de ka yin skyes lan thub pa'i sku bris tshe// bris mkhan rnams kyis ma nus thub pa nyid// chu 'gram bzhugs nas de nang gzugs brnyan la// brten nas brir bcug chu rlon ma zhes grags/ 'di la dbu dpral brdal zhing skyil krung thig /mdzod spur reg pa khyad chos gzhan rnams mtshungs// thub dbang lha gnas gso sbyong mdzad pa'i tshe// gsal ldan zhes bya wā ra ṇā si ru// rgyal po u dra la nas dran rten du// tsan dan las byas thub pa'i sku bzhengs pa// thub pa lha babs de yis gom drug bsus// tsan dan jo bor grags rtsis thang gi thub pa gser gling ma 'di rigs shing de rigs kyi// tshugs bzang gos 'khyud zhib snyoms phyag mnyen zhing*// zhabs mthil rgyags shing zhal ras dkyus ring ba'i// gi gu sha bzhin bzos pa zhig kyang 'byung*// 'di rigs stod hor zer ba 'khrul ba yin// byad sems sku la 'gying bag cung zad yod// tshugs bzang zhal ras mdzes shing skem spag ran// ral pa'i thor tshugs drang po rgyan gyis spras// nor bu gnyis pa'ang re re srid pa ste/ khro bo'i gzugs kyang 'gying bag 'tshams pa yin// khri med pa 'am yod la gyad dang ni// seng sogs rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs pa dang*// gdong gsum pa 'am 'bol gyi gdan can dang*// pad gdan yod rnams pad kha rgyas zhum snyoms// nyis brtsegs ya pad ma pad 'grig par nges// yar mar mu tig che snyoms bsgrigs legs pa// mdor na sgros gtsang mthong bas ngo mtshar bskyed// bye brag rdo rje gdan pas bzhengs pa yi// gdan chung mar grags li dkar 'ba' zhig ste// cung zad dbu chung zhal ras mkhur tshos rgyags// ma ga dhar ni thug dbang bdud 'dul dang*// chos 'khor ma ni wā ra ṇā sir dar// dbus 'gyur shar phyogs dpral mtshams dbyes phyed cing*// sku stod rgyas pas ri dwags rgyal po 'dra// zhal dkyus cung thung phyag sor dra bas 'bril// yid tsam gtsug tor rgyab tu nye ba yin// rgya gar shar phyogs phal cher li dkar te// li dmar las byas srid mtha' ma bkag tsam// kā ma ru yi rdo las grub pa yang*// lugs gtsang rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs// zhal gyi sgo mdzes spyan bar cung zad dog

/shangs stod dpangs dma' shangs smad cung zad mtho// dbus phyogs pa las shangs sgras cung zad 'dal// skem zhing tshugs bzang 'gying bag lhu tshigs ran// gos 'khyud sku la 'khril zhing zhib rtsing ran// gtsug tor rgyab tu nye ba 'ba' zhig ste// khri sogs dbus kyi lha dang mtshungs pa la// pad 'dab nyis brtsegs pad kha cung zad zhum// ya pad ma pad ma 'grig par nges shing*// yas kyi mu tig zhib snyoms mas phyogs kyis// mu tig rags snyoms dbus las cung mi gtsang*// khri gdan gdong gsum rgyab yol yod pa'ang srid// shar phyogs bye brag za hor yul gyi lha// li dkar shar phyogs lha rigs gtsang ma la// gser dngul zangs kyi gi gu sha bzhin bzos// dngul zangs spyan 'byed byas dang kha gcig la// mu tig do shal rin chen phra khung spras// mchog tu yi ger 'ong ba 'ba' zhig 'byung*// 'ga' zhig ḍi li'i lha zer 'khrul pa ste/ ḍi li nub phyogs yul gyi bye brag yin// rgya gar nub phyogs kha che'i yul gyi lha// li dkar cung zad ser dang lhag par du// li dmar rdo dang gi gu sha 'dra dang*// zi khyim dag kyang 'di la mang bar snang*// sku yi tshugs rigs zhal ras ring zhing tsho// stod smad chung dang spyan bar dog pa dang*// shangs kyi sgang zlum bzang dang zhal mchu 'thug /'gyid bag bde nyams chung zhing lhu tshigs thung*// phyag zhabs mnyen zhing zangs mchu dngul spyan mang*// na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud ring*// rags zhib 'tsham la gtsug tor nor bu nub// mu tig thod bcings mu tig do shal dang*// me tog rgyan gyis spras pa'ang srid pa yin// padma dbyig mo chig rkyang 'dab ma che// pad mgo cung rgyas kha sbyar rkyang pa'ang srid// gdan khri la sogs ci rigs yod pa yin// bye brag tshugs bzang dbus 'gyur lha 'dra la// mgul phra zhal ras sog kha dod pa dang*// phyag zhabs skye mtshams phra zhing zhabs mthil rgyags// lho phyogs lha rnams phal cher li dmar te// li dkar klu 'jim dag kyang srid pa yin// zhal ras dkyus thung sogs kha cung zad yod// sha nyams lhod cing spyan bar cung zad yangs// shangs kyi gzengs dmar dpral mtshams dbyes mi phyed// 'gyid bag bde nyams yod pa re re tsam// na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gzong ris mang*// khri pad yangs shing padma'i 'dab ma che// tshig rkyang pad mgo cung zad zhum pa la// kha ser ze'u 'bru gzong ris mdzad pa yod// kha sbyar pad rkyang ci rigs yod pa yin// tsha gser mdog dmar shin tu mthug par snang*// bye brag be ta'i yul gyi lha rigs la// gzhan rnams lho phyogs spyi dang 'dra ba la// zhal ras sog kha cung zad chung ba tsam// na bza'i rgyan la gzong ris byas pa yod// gzhan yang zhal khyim lho phyogs lha rigs la// cung zad dkyus thung spyan che shangs gong nyag

/zhal khung kyong zhing mchu sgros cung zad tsong*// rgyan gtsang dar dpyangs na bza' lhub la rags// phyag zhabs sor mo padma'i sgros mi gtsang*// padma nyis brtsegs yar mar gnyis ka ldan// steng gi mu tig med pa shes cher 'byung*// sku yi 'gying bag de nyams dod pa ste// shas cher ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa mang*// rgya gar byang phyogs li dkar ra gan dang*// cung zad bsres pas rag skya 'dra ba la// tshugs mnyen 'gying bag bde la zhal ras ni// dkyus thung sgros gtsang shangs bzang spyan bar dog /khri dang rgyan mdzes li dmar srid pa tsam// rgyu 'dra ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'ang yod// bye brag bal po'i lha yin rtogs par bla// bod la chos rgyal li ma snga phyi gsum// snga ma chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus// zi khyim li dkar li dmar gtsang ma dang*// dkar dmar sho bsgrigs byas dang gser dngul dang*/ shel dang rdo 'jim sogs la bsgrubs pa ste// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khyon yangs sha nyams 'bol// zhal ras stod smad rgyas zhum med pa la// cung zad dkyus ring shangs bzang spyan dkyus ring*// mchu sgras gtsang zhing tshugs legs sha nyams che// phyag zhabs mnyen zhing gos 'khyud nyung ba ste// phal skad lug gdong shin tu mtshar ba 'dra// lho phyogs pa dang 'dra ba'i pad gdan dang*// khrid dang 'bol gdan ci yang med pa'ang srid// na bza' ber dang zhabs la phyags gsol ba// dbu rgyan gsum pa rtse mo nang du phub// phal cher na bza' zong ris yod pa mang*// chos rgyal sku la la thod na bza' ber// phyags yod gzong ris can te tsha gser dang*// byo rtse byugs sam ci yang ma byugs pa// ra gan khro las grub na 'dra cog yin// bar pa chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dus// gzhan rnams snga ma dag dang mtshungs pa las// zhal dkyus cung thung sor mo'i sgros mi gtsang*// byo rtse byugs shing phra rnams tshon bkra bkye// gsham gyi lugs kha cung zad mi gtsang zhing*// phal cher dbu rgyan gsum pa mang ba yin// chos rgyal sku la la thod med pa la// dbu skra lan bu g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'phyang*// dbu rgyan gsum pas mdzes par brgyan pa yod// grang gser byugs dang ci yang ma byugs pa// phyi ma mnga' bdag khri ral dus su byung*// 'phags pa'i yul gyi bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i lha// li dkar rtsod med las grub yul dbus kyi// lha dang rigs 'dra khyad par 'byed pa la// zhal ras cung tsho 'gyid bag bde cha che// dngul zangs spyan 'byed phul du byung ba yod// zangs thang ma 'byung zangs mchu dngul spyan yin// ra gan las grub de las sgros mi gtsang*// li dmar las grub phyi ma dag dang mtshungs// chos li phyi ma zangs 'dres yod pa'i phyir// snga ma dag las rim pas smug pa yin// phyi ma 'di la tsha gser byugs pa nyid// bye brag lha btsun khu dbon rnam gnyis dus// zangs dmar zi khyim bsres pa zhang zhung gser// mthug por byugs pa shangs bzang sha tshugs rgyags// 'gying bag bde nyams bal po'i lha 'dra zhig

/'byung ba 'di la mthon mthing ma ru grags// hor la stod hor yul gur kha sha dang*//chu bo sī ta'i 'gram la yul 'di rnams bring chags su gnas pas so// smad hor rnam pa bzhir dbye stod hor la// dkar dmar 'dres pa'i khro li nag po dang*// smug dang nag po rgya rag las dkar tsam// stod hor rgyal po hu la hu'i khrims bcas pa'i dus lha ni zhal dkyus cung thung zhing*// sha tshugs tsho la zhal khyim zlum pa yin// na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud ring*// sul zhib chu yi gnyer ma dang mtshungs te// shangs spyan la sogs kha che'i lha dang mtshungs// pad 'dab che zhing sul can chig rkyang la// ya pad ma pad ldan zhing skeng nyag gam// dbyig ma 'dab mo spug mo che ba'am// klu yis bteg pa'i khri stan grub zhi 'am// zlum po brag ri gdan du byas pa yod// bye brag yul der rgya nag rnying ma'i bzos// khro li smug por zhal nas khyon dog cing*// sha tshugs ldig la cung zad zhal sko kong*// spyan dang mchu sgros chung zhing gos 'khyud kyi// lte ba sul mngal khri stan rgya yig dang*// rgya mi mchod rdzas gzod ris bris pa 'byung*// kha che'i bzo bos li smug la sogs la// bzos pa'i kha che'i lha dang mtshungs pa'ang 'byung*// tsha gser byugs dang ci yang ma byugs pa// yu gur yul du li dkar dngul dkar dang*// bsres pa'i dkar shas dngul gyi dbyibs 'dra dang*// khro li smug po dag las bsgrubs pa'i lha// zhal dkyus thung zhing zhal zlum shangs rgyud ran// cung zad brdal zhing skra tshogs shin tu mthug /na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud nyung*// sku yi tshugs bzang 'gyid bag cung zad gyong*// phyag zhabs sor mo cung zad sgros mi gtsang*// rgyan kyang ha cang mi mang cung zad 'byig /phal cher pad gdan bzhugs sa khri med pa mang*// yod rnams stod hor lha dang mtshungs pa yin// kha sha zhes pa li yul dag gi ming*// lha rigs chos li snga ma dag dang mtshungs//bsam yas dge rgyas kyi lha dang g.yu ru khra 'brug gi lha rnams de nas phebs par bshad pas so//

smad hor lha ni zhal ras smad rgyas shing*// spyan dang mchu sgros chung la zhal khung ldem// phyag zhabs gzhon sha chags shing sor mo thung*// na bza' lhub cing gos 'khyud rtsing zhib ran// khri dang brag ri'i steng du bzhugs pa mang*// khro li smug dang khro dkar shing las byas// bye brag hor gyis rgya nag 'dzin pa'i dus//rgyal po go dan nas ye sun the mur gyi bar rgyal rabs drug gis 'dzin pa'i dus/ cong li dang ni de dang li dmar bsres// tsha gser gyis byugs tshugs sogs rgya nag bzhin// tsan dan shir shing phal pa'i shing dang ni// shel rigs ma na ho dang g.yang tre'u sogs// rdo rigs dag las byas dang bse ru dang*// gser dngul zi khyim dag kyang srid pa yin// rgya nag rnying ma dang ni gsar ma gnyis// rgya nag thang ce'u'i rgyal brgyud kyis 'dzin pa'i dus rnying ma'i lha rigs sha spag cing*// shangs legs zhal kyong mchu sgros shin tu gtsang*// zhal dkyus cung rings spyan ni phra ba dang*// na bza' dar dpyangs lhub la gos 'khyud gtsang*// rgyan sprod mang zhing gtsang sha 'thon pa yod// phyag ni cung thung sor mo dod pa yin// 'ga' zhig lha dang rgyal po'i dbyibs dod tsam// zhal ras gzong gis brad tsam byas pa'ang 'byung*// rgyu ni li dkar dmar bsres pa'i khro li nag smug gnyis su nges// rgya nag ta ming rgyal brgyud gyis 'dzin pa'i dus gsar ma tshugs dang brang brdar gtsang*// gser mdog legs la sha rgyags gis 'khyud legs// zhal ras cung leb spyan dkyus ring ba yin// padma kha sbyar nyis brtsegs rgyab mdun 'khor// yar mar rtse gnyis cung zad phyir gyed pa// gong 'og mu tig phra zhib bstar dkyus snyoms// zhabs sdoms legs shing rdo rje rgya gram spras// de la zho rtsi nges par byugs pa yin// bye brag cung zad gtsang sha chung ba dang*// rdo rje rgya gram mtshal dang yi ge med// sku rim mar grags rgyu ni rgya rag dang*// rag skya ci rigs 'byung ba rtogs par bla// rgya gar sangs rgyas byang sems sku nyid dar// sngags sku bla ma'i sku ni srid pa tsam// ci yang ma byugs pa dang 'dzam klung gser// yi ger 'ong bar gsol ba ci rigs 'byung*// rgya nag gsar rnying hor sogs phal mo cher// sangs rgyas byang sems sku mang bla ma'i sku// re re tsam 'byung rgyal po'i sku yang srid// rgya gar shar phyogs dang ni rgya nag tu// spungs sku shin tu dar bar byung ba yin// mchod rten lha babs rnam rgyal rgya gar las// srid mtha' ma bkag tsam zhig bod du phebs// bod kyi pad spungs lcags lte me zhabs can// la mtshal byugs pa ma mnyam jo bo rje'i// phyag nas mar grags tshad ldan gtam las byung*// rna thos bskyar min rtog dpyod mig zhib mos// brtags pas yid ches gnas su cis mi rung*// gsung rten hor shog 'bol mnyen khro ba gnyis// dang po gla rtsi gan shog ces su grags// phyi ma hor gyi shog bu phal pa ste// rgya gar shog bu phal ni mnyen pa mang*// gser la 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzang dang*// tshe ring bya yis zos pa'i brun gyi gser// dkar ser 'khrug pa gser gyi mchog tu bshad// de 'og gar log gser ni dmar dmas che// de las gzhan pa phal pa'i gser du 'dod// mon shog la sogs brtag par bla ba'i phyir// de dag las grub gsung rab tshogs rnams ni// khyad par gos shog ces grags mnyen zhing 'jam// dmar skya me tog zlum rtsegs ri mo can// baiḍūrya yi zhun ma sngo skyas bris// baiḍūrya yi glegs bam zhes grags so// de ltar rten brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa nyung du 'di/
dge slong padma dkar pos/ mkhyen brtse dbon po tshe dbang kun mkhyen dang*/ mkhas skor ba rnal 'byor nyams dga' blo bde'i ched du bkod pa rdzogs so// //maṅga laṃ// //
